name: @subkit/desktop
description: SubKit Desktop: a hardened shell that loads the Cockpit of a SubKit server and brings its attention items to the tray and to native notifications.
author: Mike Bild

scripts.package: bun run scripts/build.ts --production && bun run scripts/notices.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dir: bun run scripts/build.ts --production && bun run scripts/notices.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.package:dev: bun run scripts/build.ts && bun run scripts/notices.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --dir
